notes: Draft configuration: The independently mapped July 2020 full Hanoi Street Circuit retains both northern sweeping sections, the long eastern straight and southern hairpin, excluding the separate pit lane. Formula 1 documents completion of the 23-turn hybrid circuit in February 2020 and its 5.613 km configuration. The 5618.6 m source route matches the catalogue branch identity and remains unscaled against its 5622 m timing scalar. This is a historical built-course draft; the identification reference announcing a planned race does not establish that the race occurred. Temporary barrier and carriageway alignment remain provisional. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 5618.6 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 78 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
